narrative:
Wyandot County has 14,380 registered voters, with 15.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 41.7%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.2% of registrants.
